title: Writing "Flat Blues" after Bessie Smith's "Backwater Blues"
summary: Okeh wanted a flood blues after Bessie's hit, so she wrote one in 1927 and explains the three-minute record limit.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
